integrity: The statement is reconstructed from direct tame Kummer valuations, genus equality, an Apéry residue computation, and Dedekind reciprocity. Exact checks cover finite parameter pairs; there is no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the gap-defined weight at infinity on even Ma–Wang curves is evaluated. Generic Kummer gap-set and semigroup algorithms are established prior work; the contribution is the new explicit polynomial, Dedekind evaluation, and strict normalized law. No claim about global Wronskian weights in small characteristic or other points.
title: Exact gap-excess weight and asymptotic law at infinity on even Ma–Wang maximal curves
